_comment: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a recording of any site.
Reproduces the response shape of the mangakakalot-family chapter API:
Why synthetic: see testdata/home.html. No real host or title appears here.
ADVERSARIAL ON PURPOSE: the list is **descending**, newest chapter first,
which is the order the real API answers in. PLAN §7.2 requires Chapters()
to return ascending reading order, so a theme that forgot to reverse this
would assemble a volume that reads backwards — and this fixture makes that
a red test rather than a silent ruined PDF.
Other variations the test exercises: a decorative title carrying a second
number ('Chapter 4: Four Lamps'), a half chapter, an entry whose
chapter_num is null so the number has to come from the title, and an
